unique_value: tool dispatch is default-deny and requires an explicit role/tool/scope grant plus a known tool schema before authorization
required arguments are enforced and every supplied argument must be explicitly schema-allowed, preventing silent parameter broadening
explicit request identifiers are single-use across both ALLOW and REFUSE decisions and reservation is synchronized for concurrent callers
dispatch receipts bind role, tool, scope, normalized arguments, request identity, verdict, reason, and decision details without executing the tool itself

lineage_distinction.GlacierEQ/openai-reasoning-budget-future: owns precommitted reasoning-resource budgets; complementary resource-authority plane, not tool-dispatch authority

capability_contribution.ownership: This repository remains the owning OpenAI-specialist implementation of scoped replay-safe tool authority; capability extraction preserves repository identity and lineage.

next_evolution: Add signed/expiring/revocable grants, explicit effect classes and approval requirements, capability attenuation, and a provider adapter that preserves exact request identity through execution and confirmation while retaining default-deny and one-shot replay semantics.
